test.create_query: CREATE TABLE qcc_rb (URL String, SearchPhrase String, Title String, UserID Int64) ENGINE = File(Parquet)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO qcc_rb SELECT URL, SearchPhrase, Title, UserID FROM hits_10m_single
test.query: SELECT SearchPhrase, min(URL), count() AS c FROM qcc_rb WHERE URL LIKE '%google%' AND SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null

SELECT SearchPhrase, min(URL), min(Title), count() AS c, count(DISTINCT UserID) FROM qcc_rb WHERE Title LIKE '%Google%' AND URL NOT LIKE '%.google.%' AND SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM qcc_rb WHERE URL != '' AND SearchPhrase != '' FORMAT Null
